title: Fixed Oblique Double Cone Vessel and Twin Pedestal Blender
description: One newly authored whole fixed double-cone tumbling-blender-inspired machine exterior. One complete vessel has a short wide cylindrical middle and two opposite full conical shoulders, ending in separate polar necks. Its long vessel axis is fixed at an oblique angle, perpendicular to a full horizontal transverse trunnion shaft. Two whole tall tapered pedestals, complete bearing-block exteriors, two long ground skids and full crossmembers carry the complete assembly. A full closed upper access lid, annular clamp exterior and complete bridge handle remain at one polar end; a short closed lower valve and discharge-end exterior with its full side lever occupy the other. A separate complete side reduction-box exterior, upright motor and blank control are visibly joined to the right bearing assembly. No old drum, composter, concrete-mixer cradle or kneader parts imported or resized. Unlike the side-open garden cylinder it has no lateral door, vent slots or rotating drum about its own long axis; unlike the open pear concrete drum it has no internal paddles, U cradle, axle wheels or tilt handwheel; unlike the double curved kneader it has no open trough or two independent internal twisted blades. The entire double-conical vessel, transverse support arrangement and complete outboard drive organization are newly authored. One whole model zero scenes. Closed schematic exterior only, no visible or claimed vessel interior, actual fluid/powder passage, bearing fit, tumbling trajectory, mixing result, drive internals, polar valve action, charge, food contact, hygiene, pressure, capacity, power, engineering, manufacture or safety capability. No brands or copied performance dimensions. Rigging animation physics and interaction not made.
